label: Mid-phrase word that leaves a dependent complement open, where a 'based on / due to / according to / depending on' style qualifier could come next: a noun like 'life expectancy' or 'target', a modal-ish 'allowed' or 'fail', or a Python attribute or key access (url = self.request.url, meta['url']). Weak and mixed: the strong activations are a grab-bag, not one token.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top and band examples are heterogeneous (code attribute/key access, 'allowed', 'life expectancy', 'Kyoto target', 'appropriate to students' age'); output promotes ' based', ' due', ' according', ' depending', suggesting a prediction of a dependent qualifier. Very sparse pole (0.01% above 0.3 of max); no single token or topic covers it, so this label is a speculative shared-function guess.
